# Walters W.73, zodiac and wind diagrams

The zodiac diagram and the rota of the winds with their profile heads, from Walters Ms. W.73, a late 12th-century scientific miscellany, grouped by folio (1r and 1v).

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `walters-w73`, historical, 26 assets, version 1.0.0.
